automation.publishRule: Redeploy only when accepted evidence changes

migration.change: The materially expanded Static, Hybrid, Managed, cross-platform, mobile, Managed Preview, and GA scope replaces the narrow 45/45/10 phase model with M0–M8 weights 8/14/12/20/14/12/7/6/7.
migration.creditRule: Only accepted artifacts with smoke evidence were remapped. Blocked and not-started work received zero; live health and draft/submission state received zero. This manifest is the only current weighted score.
migration.activationGate: Schema v3 activated after issue #16 was reviewed, merged, and deployed. Subsequent accepted evidence updates this same tracker; the schema-v2 49.75/100 audit remains immutable history.

scoreHistory.reason: Preserved historical audit before the accepted full-platform denominator migration. It is evidence history, not a second current score.

methodology.formula: Overall completion is earned task weight divided by the one 100-point M0–M8 plan. Current accepted evidence earns 18/100: M0 6/8, M1 5/14, M2 1/12, M3 0.5/20, M4 3/14, M5 0/12, M6 0/7, M7 0.5/6, and M8 2/7.

statusCredit.complete: Earned points equal task weight only after accepted artifact, smoke evidence, and required review
statusCredit.in_progress: Only explicit accepted partial credit; this migration assigns none to incomplete expanded-scope tasks

methodology.approvalRule: Account, identity, submission, store, payment, public-launch, and other owner gates stay at zero until actually cleared. Prepared engineering is credited only in a separately weighted task.
methodology.etaRule: The accepted capability, rights/commercial, and Aerial parity contracts remove their completed task estimates from the prior active range, leaving 125–237 hands-on hours. Microsoft enterprise distribution and Google A2A remain outside the weighted scope.
methodology.timeRule: Hands-on effort, the separate 48–72 hour clean-machine/energy soak, deferred initiatives, recurring operations, and external waits are reported separately.
methodology.healthRule: Public endpoint checks are guardrails only. Their results never change earned completion points.

gates: Apple Developer identity, signing, and notarization
